name: Birdwatcher Tadhg

intro.text: Fulmars! Look, a fulmar! Don't look at it, it'll spit. It's the single worst defence in birds.

win: Splendid. I'll note it in my logbook as a minor spectacle.
after: A fulmar can spit oil at attackers up to a metre away. It's a bird with a water pistol and a personality.
